cards.ex: It suddenly dawned on me that I hadn't turned off the oven!
cards.exUz: Birdan o'chog'ni o'chirmaganim ongimga keldi!
cards.uzDef: Birdan tushunib yetmoq, bir fikr miyaga kelmoq.

cards.ex: It's tough, but I'm determined to kick the habit of biting my nails.
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin tirnoqlarimni tishlash odatini tashlashga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatdan butunlay voz kechmoq.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, many good intentions fall by the wayside when life gets busy.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, hayot band bo'lib qolganda ko'p yaxshi niyatlar unut bo'lib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan narsa amalga oshmay qolmoq, unutilmoq.

cards.ex: I have to make a conscious effort to drink more water throughout the day.
cards.exUz: Kun davomida ko'proq suv ichish uchun ongli urinishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ataylab harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I always set the alarm for 6 AM, even on weekends.
cards.exUz: Men har doim budilnikni ertalab soat 6 ga qo'yaman, hatto dam olish kunlari ham.
cards.uzDef: Uyg'onish uchun budilnik soatini o'rnatmoq.

cards.ex: After the vacation, I wanted to hit the ground running at work.
cards.exUz: Ta'tildan keyin men ishda tez boshlashni xohladim.
cards.uzDef: Ishni darhol energiya va g'ayrat bilan boshlamoq.

cards.ex: He's such a regular fixture at the library that everyone knows him.
cards.exUz: U kutubxonaning shunchalik doimiy qatnashchisiki, uni hamma taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror joyda yoki tadbirda doimo bor bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: It takes a few weeks to get into the swing of things at a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishga kirishish uchun bir necha hafta kerak bo'ladi.
cards.term: get into the swing of things
cards.uzDef: Yangi faoliyatga yoki vaziyatga moslashmoq.

cards.ex: Checking my phone first thing in the morning is an ingrained habit.
cards.exUz: Ertalab birinchi navbatda telefonimni tekshirish - bu o'rnashgan odat.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida shakllangan kuchli odat.

cards.ex: I try to carve out time each week to volunteer at the animal shelter.
cards.exUz: Men har hafta hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lish uchun vaqt ajratishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Band bo'lishga qaramay, vaqt topmoq.

cards.ex: Our team works like a well-oiled machine; we're very efficient.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoamiz juda samarali, sozlangan mexanizm kabi ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda samarali va yaxshi tashkil etilgan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm in the habit of making a to-do list every morning.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni ertalab ishlar ro'yxatini tuzish odatiga egaman.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda biror narsa qilish odati bor.

cards.ex: I'm a creature of comfort; I love my routine and familiar surroundings.
cards.exUz: Men qulaylik shinavandasiman; Men o'z odatimni va tanish muhitni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Qulaylik va odatiy narsalarni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I often get bogged down in the details and lose sight of the bigger picture.
cards.exUz: Men ko'pincha tafsilotlarga ko'milib qolaman va katta maqsadni unutaman.
cards.uzDef: Ish yoki muammolarga ko'milib qolmoq.

cards.ex: I call my mother every Sunday without fail.
cards.exUz: Men har yakshanba kuni onamga albatta qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon o'tkazib yubormasdan, har doim.

cards.ex: The stress of the job eventually took its toll on his health.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi oxir-oqibat uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: I check my emails as a matter of routine when I get to the office.
cards.exUz: Ofisga kelganimda odat bo'yicha elektron pochtamni tekshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda, odatdagi usulda.

cards.ex: I felt like I was in a rut, so I decided to take a pottery class.
cards.exUz: Men zerikarli hayot kechirayotgandek his qildim, shuning uchun kulolchilik kursiga yozilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Zerikarli va o'zgarishsiz hayot kechirmoq.

cards.ex: I'm finally making headway with my fitness goals after a few months of training.
cards.exUz: Bir necha oylik mashg'ulotlardan so'ng, nihoyat fitness maqsadlarimga erishyabman.
cards.uzDef: Progress qilmoq, maqsadga tomon siljimoq.

cards.ex: I have a standing appointment with my therapist every Tuesday at 2 PM.
cards.exUz: Har seshanba kuni soat 14:00 da terapevt bilan doimiy uchrashuvim bor.
cards.uzDef: Har doim bir xil vaqtda rejalashtirilgan uchrashuv.

cards.ex: I often get sidetracked when I'm trying to work from home.
cards.exUz: Uyda ishlashga harakat qilganimda ko'pincha chalg'iyman.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy vazifadan uzoqlashmoq.

cards.ex: My weekends usually follow a set pattern: relaxing on Saturday and catching up on chores on Sunday.
cards.exUz: Mening dam olish kunlarim odatda belgilangan tartibda o'tadi: shanba kuni dam olish va yakshanba kuni uy ishlarini bajarish.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda takrorlanadigan xatti-harakatlar yoki voqealar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: Even when challenged, she stuck to her guns and defended her beliefs.
cards.exUz: U qarshilikka duch kelganida ham, o'z fikrida turdi va e'tiqodlarini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikridan qaytmaslik, qat'iy bo'lish.

cards.ex: I try to make the most of my commute by listening to podcasts.
cards.exUz: Men ishga borish vaqtimdan podkastlarni tinglash orqali maksimal darajada foydalanishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan eng yaxshi natijaga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Buying coffee every day fuels my caffeine habit.
cards.exUz: Har kuni kofe sotib olish mening kofein odatimni kuchaytiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror odatni davom ettirish yoki kuchaytirish.

cards.ex: His terrible cooking is a standing joke in our family.
cards.exUz: Uning yomon ovqati bizning oilada doimiy hazildir.
cards.uzDef: Biror guruh ichida doimiy ravishda hazillashiladigan mavzu.

cards.ex: She's been burning the candle at both ends to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: U loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun juda ko'p ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ishlash, o'z kuchini sarflash.

cards.ex: We need to nip this bad habit in the bud before it becomes a real problem.
cards.exUz: Bu yomon odat haqiqiy muammoga aylanishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshlanishida yo'q qilmoq, oldini olmoq.

cards.ex: I have to keep a check on my spending habits to stay within my budget.
cards.exUz: Byudjetimdan chiqib ketmaslik uchun xarajatlarimni nazorat qilib turishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani doimiy nazoratda ushlab turmoq.

cards.ex: Driving a car has become second nature to me after all these years.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomida mashina haydash men uchun ikkinchi tabiatga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Odatga aylanib qolgan, tabiiydek bo'lib qolgan narsa.
